dedupe_keys.name: kpx hourly national electricity demand south korea mainland and jeju on the public data portal

description: The Korea Power Exchange, which runs the Korean electricity market and power system operation, publishes hourly national electricity demand at the generation end on the national Public Data Portal. Each row gives a date and the 24 hourly demand values in MWh, including both the mainland and Jeju; the latest file, for 2025, has 366 rows and was registered on 23 February 2026, with yearly updates and the next release planned for 23 February 2027. KPX notes that the values are provisional data used for demand forecasting, and the list was renamed from hourly electricity demand to hourly national electricity demand on 7 August 2024. The file is a free CSV download without login, and the portal also converts it to an open API in JSON and XML, which needs a portal account and application; the licence field states no restriction on use. Coverage is South Korea. Caveats: figures are provisional, a column definition file explains the fields, and each release is a single year so a long series needs several files. Simulation uses are national load curves for adequacy and dispatch models and demand sensitivity to heat waves and cold spells. Related records: data-epsis-korea-electric-power-statistics gives the wider KPX statistics.
